name: Planning Ahead
overview: Scripture emphasizes the wisdom of diligent planning and preparation, as seen in the example of the ant who wisely considers her ways (Proverbs 6:6). It teaches that seeking counsel provides safety and direction, preventing downfall (Proverbs 11:14), while recognizing that although a person may devise their plans, it is ultimately the Lord who directs their steps (Proverbs 16:9). The diligent are promised abundance through careful thought, contrasting with the haste that leads to want (Proverbs 21:5), and Jesus highlights the importance of building on a solid foundation through obedience to His words (Matthew 7:24). Conversely, slothfulness is equated with wastefulness, underscoring the need for purposeful action in planning ahead (Proverbs 18:9).
